name: Synthetic bank-to-ledger reconciliation review
description: Proposed generic synthetic scenario for read-only, exact bank-versus-internal-ledger matching and human review of residual cases; it authorizes no enterprise action.
processNode: Proposed: compare a bounded bank snapshot with an internal-ledger snapshot before a human resolves residual differences; the target-enterprise as-is process is missing.
decisionOrAction: Proposed read-only decision: present exact matches and a human review queue; no ledger, bank, or other system record is changed.

metrics.name: Reconciliation review cycle time
metrics.definition: Proposed elapsed time from receiving both bounded snapshots to a human-ready residual review queue; no target-enterprise measurement is supplied.
metrics.target: proposed: target-enterprise owner must set and accept a target

ontologyReferences.purpose: Synthetic local definition shape only; target-enterprise semantic acceptance is unverifiable.

sourceReferences.purpose: Synthetic local snapshot only; target-enterprise source access and authority are missing.

acceptanceCriteria: Proposed synthetic replay emits a read-only exact-match result with semantic version, source evidence, freshness, access decision, and writeBack false.
Proposed synthetic replay sends ambiguous or unmatched records to human review and fails closed for invalid, duplicate, stale, conflicting, or unauthorized inputs.
Missing: target-enterprise owner must accept process, access, baseline, target, and production criteria before any enterprise use.
notes: Evidence ledger: target-enterprise owner, process baseline, target, source authority, access, integration, acceptance, and write-back authorization are missing or unverifiable. The local fixture and its local access decision are proposed synthetic controls only.
